sloka: एवम् उक्तवतः तस्य रावणस्य शिखि प्रभे ।क्रुद्धस्य हरि पर्यन्ते रक्ते नेत्रे बभूवतुः ॥३-४९-५॥
transliteration: evam uktavataḥ tasya rāvaṇasya śikhi prabhe ।kruddhasya hari paryante rakte netre babhūvatuḥ ॥3-49-5॥

translations.english: As Ravana exploded in anger, his ambercoloured eyes turned red like the radiance of the flaming fire, and almost as bright as the Sun.
